openQuestions: The sample flashcard file has no factsToCheck key, so to keep the shape exact each deck's dated and numeric facts are listed here under files[].factsToCheck instead of inside the deck.
The 12 existing app decks were not in the project, so topic overlap with them could not be checked. Topics here avoid the sample deck (Buddhist councils).
History decks use the anc, med and mod prefixes (4 decks in all); none use art.
Battles, the 1857 revolt, Jallianwala Bagh, Chauri Chaura and disasters are left out (TRAGIC rule).
env-deck-protected-areas: the national park vs sanctuary wording on people's rights should be checked against WLPA sections 33 and 35.
mod-deck-gandhian-movements: Ahmedabad 1918 is described as Gandhi's fast in support of the workers; NCERT wording should be confirmed.
Hindi is a first draft and needs the Hindi editor, especially technical terms: दुर्बलतामंडल, अवनालिका अपरदन, पारिस्थितिक निकेत, कुंजी प्रजाति, क्वार की उमस.
